full_page.content:
1951, May 30
The following is a faithful transcription of the photo copy of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. St. Felix Friary Huntington, Ind. May 30th, 1951
Blessed be God in all His designs.
God bless you Mr. and Mrs. H. Ricard.
We shall be pleased to see you as proposed, or at your convenience. We hope of course that you may not be disapointed. Sincerely yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus,. O.F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Mrs. H. J. (Bernadine L.) Ricard 2119 Seventh Street Bay City, Michigan 48706
